prompts.title: 超现实主义风格柠檬汽水罐头
prompts.description: 针对 Google Gemini App 上的 Nano Banana Pro 提示词，旨在生成一幅超现实主义的写实杰作。画面呈现一罐充满活力的柠檬汽水，从混乱且极具动感的液体爆炸中破茧而出。整体强调极致的细节表现、电影级的精准构图以及高能爆发力，并以温暖的橙色渐变作为背景。
prompts.content: A masterpiece of hyper-realistic surrealism, a single, vibrant can of sun-drenched yellow and verdant green lemonade emerges dynamically from a chaotic explosion of liquid joy. Embossed across its surface, the promise "LEMONADE" is written in pristine, bold white letters. It vibrantly dances amidst a cascading fountain of crystal-clear water droplets and fresh lime slices, a high-octane celebration of citrus and ice. Set against a luminous, warm orange gradient background, bathed in the brightest, most piercing light, this is an ultra-detailed, high-resolution vision of pure, refreshing energy. Every water droplet, pulp fiber, and metal texture is rendered with cinematic precision far beyond reality, creating a highly detailed and unforgettable experience that makes the imagination thirsty.
prompts.translatedContent: 这是一幅超写实主义的艺术杰作：一罐充满活力的、融合了暖阳黄与青翠绿的柠檬汽水，从液体喷薄而出的狂欢中动态跃现。罐身醒目地印有纯白色粗体 “LEMONADE” 字样，承载着清爽的承诺。它在晶莹剔透的水滴与鲜嫩青柠片的簇拥下翩翩起舞，宛如一场柑橘与冰块的高能庆典。在明亮的暖橙色渐变背景映衬下，整幅画面沐浴在极具穿透力的强光中，呈现出一种超细腻、高分辨率的纯粹清爽能量。每一滴水珠、每一丝果肉纤维以及金属的质感，都经过了超越现实的电影级精密渲染，营造出一种细节丰富且令人难忘的视觉体验，瞬间勾起感官的渴望。

prompts.title: 黄昏时分的屋顶编辑风格人像摄影
prompts.description: 针对 Nano Banana Pro 的极高细节、写实级提示词，旨在生成一张 Sydney Sweeney 的全身时尚大片。画面中，她身着单色白色定制套装，置身于黄昏时分的现代屋顶露台，重点突出专业摄影参数、光影效果及构图。
prompts.content:
A person from the reference photo stands upright on a rooftop terrace, facing forward with a confident posture. One hand is in the trouser pocket, the other holds a small structured handbag. Shoulders relaxed, head straight with a natural tilt, gaze forward with a calm, self-assured expression.

Outfit:
Monochromatic white tailored look — sleeveless draped blouse tucked into high-waisted wide-leg trousers with clean pleats. A matching structured blazer is draped over the shoulders. Pointed high heels in a neutral tone. Accessories include layered delicate necklaces, medium hoop earrings, a bracelet, and a small top-handle handbag.
Setting:
Modern rooftop terrace with glass railing overlooking a city skyline at dusk. Background buildings glow with soft lights, creating a subtle bokeh effect. Cool blue evening sky contrasts with warm city lights.

Composition & Camera:
Full-body vertical portrait (9:16), subject centered. Eye-level perspective capturing the full outfit and stance. Clean architectural framing with balanced space.
Lighting:
Soft natural twilight mixed with subtle artificial city lighting. Even, diffused illumination with gentle shadows. Neutral-to-cool color tones with slight warm highlights.

Style & Quality:
Professional editorial / lifestyle photography, photorealistic. Shot as if on Canon EOS 5D Mark IV, 85mm lens, f/2.0. Sharp focus on subject, realistic depth of field, smooth transitions, natural skin texture, visible details, no over-processing. Ultra-detailed, 8K quality.
Negative Prompt:
CGI, 3D render, fake/plastic skin, over-smoothing, AI artifacts, distortions, extra limbs, bad anatomy, heavy filters, excessive retouching, harsh HDR, motion blur, out of focus.
prompts.translatedContent:
参考照片中的人物直立于屋顶露台上，面向前方，姿态自信。一只手插在裤兜里，另一只手提着一只小巧且挺括的手提包。肩膀放松，头部端正并自然倾斜，目光直视前方，神情冷静且从容。

穿搭：
纯白单色定制套装 —— 无袖垂坠感衬衫扎入高腰阔腿西装裤中，裤腿带有清晰的褶皱。肩部披着一件配套的挺括西装外套。脚穿中性色调的尖头高跟鞋。配饰包括叠戴的精致项链、中号圆环耳环、一只手镯以及一只小号手柄包。

场景：
现代屋顶露台，配有玻璃栏杆，俯瞰黄昏时的城市天际线。背景建筑散发着柔和的灯光，营造出微妙的虚化（bokeh）效果。冷蓝色的夜空与温暖的城市灯光形成对比。

构图与相机：
全身垂直肖像（9:16），主体居中。平视透视，捕捉完整的穿搭与站姿。构图线条简洁，具有建筑美感，空间平衡。

光照：
柔和的自然暮光与微妙的城市人工灯光交织。光照均匀且分散，带有轻微的阴影。色调介于中性至冷色之间，伴有轻微的暖色高光。

风格与质量：
专业时尚社论 / 生活方式摄影，照片级写实。效果如同使用 Canon EOS 5D Mark IV，85mm 镜头，f/2.0 光圈拍摄。主体对焦清晰，景深真实，过渡平滑，皮肤纹理自然，细节可见，无过度处理。超细腻，8K 画质。

负面提示词（Negative Prompt）：
CGI，3D 渲染，假脸/塑料感皮肤，过度平滑，AI 瑕疵，畸形，多余的肢体，解剖结构错误，重度滤镜，过度修图，生硬的 HDR，运动模糊，失焦。

prompts.title: 克什米尔芥末花海中的电影感人像
prompts.description: 针对 Google Gemini Nano Banana Pro 的极具细节感的电影级提示词，旨在生成一张超写实的人像摄影：一名年轻男子站在克什米尔（Kashmir）广袤且充满活力的黄色芥末田中心，背景是连绵的雪山。画面侧重于柔和的自然日光、浅景深效果以及专业摄影级的画质。
prompts.content:
A highly realistic cinematic portrait of a young man standing in a vast mustard field in Kashmir during the spring season. The field is filled with bright yellow mustard blooms stretching endlessly into the distance, gently swaying in a soft breeze. Snow capped mountains are faintly visible far in the background under a clear blue sky, adding depth and a natural Kashmiri landscape feel.

The young man stands relaxed among the tall mustard plants, slightly brushing the flowers with his hand while looking calmly toward the horizon. His expression is peaceful and natural. His hair moves softly in the breeze, adding a sense of motion.

He is wearing a simple light outfit, a white shirt with rolled sleeves and dark pants, creating a clean contrast against the vibrant yellow flowers. The sunlight falls warmly across his face and shoulders, creating natural highlights and soft shadows with realistic skin texture.

The scene feels fresh and bright with soft natural daylight illuminating the field. Small details like moving flowers, distant hills, and light wind add realism.

Captured like professional outdoor photography using a DSLR camera with an 85mm lens. Shallow depth of field keeps the young man in sharp focus while the mustard field softly blurs in the background. Ultra photorealistic lighting, cinematic color grading, high dynamic range, extremely detailed, 8k resolution.
prompts.translatedContent:
一张高度写实的电影感肖像，展现了一位年轻男子在春季克什米尔广袤的芥末花田中的场景。金灿灿的芥末花海无边无际地延伸至远方，在微风中轻轻摇曳。远景处，白雪皑皑的山峦在晴朗的蓝天下若隐若现，为画面增添了深度和地道的克什米尔自然风情。

年轻男子神态放松地站在高大的芥末丛中，手轻轻拂过花朵，平静地望向地平线。他的表情宁静自然，头发在风中微微飘动，为画面增添了动感。

他穿着简约的浅色服装——一件卷起袖子的白色衬衫搭配深色长裤，与鲜艳的黄色花海形成了鲜明的对比。阳光温暖地洒在他的脸庞和肩膀上，营造出自然的亮部与柔和的阴影，皮肤纹理清晰真实。

整个场景清新明亮，柔和的自然光照亮了整片花田。摇曳的花朵、远处的山丘和微风等细节增强了真实感。

采用专业户外摄影风格，使用 DSLR 相机和 85mm 镜头拍摄。浅景深效果使男子主体清晰锐利，而背景中的芥末田则呈现出柔和的虚化感。极致写实的灯光、电影级调色、高动态范围（HDR）、细节极其丰富、8k 分辨率。

prompts.title: 巴黎高级时装编辑三联画提示，适用于 Nano Banana Pro
prompts.description: 一个为 Gemini Nano Banana (Nano Banana Pro) 设计的详细图像生成提示，要求创作一幅以巴黎女性为主题的高级时装编辑三联画，重点突出一条从她连衣裙上散开的红色线头沿着鹅卵石街道蜿蜒的超现实细节。
prompts.content:
A high-fashion editorial triptych featuring a young French woman with a messy brunette bob and a natural smile. She is wearing a long, form-fitting knit dress with horizontal red and white stripes, paired with classic brown leather loafers and a vintage crossbody bag. The style is effortlessly elegant with a "je ne sais quoi" Parisian vibe.
​The Surreal Detail:
The focal point is the hem of the dress, which is visibly unraveled. A single, vibrant red thread of yarn has come loose and extends outward, trailing behind her along the cobblestone street like a thin, continuous line, connecting her to an unseen point in the distance.
​Setting & Atmosphere:
​Location: A narrow, historic street in Paris with beige stone buildings and a traditional "TABAC" brasserie in the background.
​Lighting: Soft, overcast daylight that brings out the richness of the red yarn and the texture of the cobblestones.
​Composition: A three-panel layout showing a close-up of the frayed hem, a full-length shot of her walking, and a medium shot focusing on her expression and the dress texture.
prompts.translatedContent:
一套时尚大片三联画，描绘了一位年轻的法国女性，她留着凌乱的棕色波波头，面带自然的微笑。她身穿一件修身长款针织连衣裙，上面有红白相间的横条纹，搭配经典的棕色乐福鞋和复古斜挎包。整体风格轻松优雅，散发着“我不知道是什么”的巴黎风情。
​超现实细节：
焦点是连衣裙的下摆，它明显已经散开。一根鲜艳的红色毛线松脱出来，向外延伸，沿着鹅卵石街道在她身后拖曳，像一条细长的连续线条，将她与远处一个看不见的点连接起来。
​场景与氛围：
​地点：巴黎一条狭窄的历史街道，背景是米色石砌建筑和一家传统的“TABAC”小酒馆。
​光线：柔和的阴天日光，突出了红色毛线的浓郁色彩和鹅卵石的质感。
​构图：三联画布局，展示了磨损下摆的特写、她行走的全身照以及聚焦于她的表情和连衣裙质地的中景照。

prompts.content: Create a realistic photo of a quiet residential street in soft daylight, with natural lighting and a calm atmosphere. The scene looks like a candid everyday moment, with houses, road signs, and trees in the background. In the foreground, add a hand-drawn sketch-style character interacting with the real world - the character is crouching and gently petting a small cat on the street. The character is drawn in a simple pencil sketch style with visible lines, slightly rough and artistic, like it’s drawn on top of the photo. Blend the sketch and real environment naturally so it feels connected and emotional. Cinematic composition, soft lighting, peaceful mood, realistic background with artistic sketch overlay.
